timeline.threshold: Age checks for adult / sensitive content
timeline.summary: Platforms rolled out face-scan or ID age checks for mature content under the Online Safety Act (e.g. Reddit from 14 July 2025; X and Discord from 25 July 2025; Spotify facial checks August 2025).

timeline.threshold: Under 16 barred from covered social accounts
timeline.summary: Nationwide ban requiring covered platforms to prevent under-16s from holding accounts. Took effect 10 December 2025; later fine-doubling proposals followed evidence of bypasses.

timeline.threshold: Under-16 social accounts linked to guardian; reliable age verification
timeline.summary: Digital Statute of Children and Adolescents requires reliable age verification (no self-declaration alone) and linking under-16 social media accounts to a legal guardian.

timeline.threshold: Under 16 barred on designated high-risk platforms
timeline.summary: Gradual deactivation of under-16 accounts on high-risk platforms including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, Bigo Live and Roblox.

timeline.threshold: Under 16; platforms must verify age or face fines
timeline.summary: Under-16 social media ban took effect 1 June 2026. Platforms must verify ages and remove under-16 accounts or face fines of up to RM1 million.

timeline.law: Under-15 social media ban + age verification
timeline.threshold: Under 15 barred; age verification + parental tools for older minors
timeline.summary: Parliament banned social media services for under-15s and required age-verification systems. Enters force six months after Official Gazette publication. Separate e-Devlet real-ID login for all users remained a draft as of April 2026.
Government-backed measure to ban or tightly restrict social media for under-15s, with age-verification systems; targeted for the 2026 school year.

timeline.threshold: Digital majority 16; name, address and NIP verification
timeline.summary: Digital age of majority 16 with parental consent for younger users. Platforms must verify full identity (name, address, Personal Identification Number), not a bare age check. 12-month transition to February 2027.

timeline.law: Cabinet resolution on children's social media access
timeline.threshold: Under 15 barred; digital ID / AI age checks
timeline.summary: Minimum age 15 for personal social accounts; robust verification including digital identity and AI-supported methods (no self-declaration). Phase one names X, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat and TikTok. 12-month transition to June 2027.

legislative_efforts.title: Utah Minor Protection in Social Media Act / Social Media Regulation Act
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires age assurance and parental consent for minors on social media, plus curfew-style use limits. Federal courts have enjoined key provisions; state continues appeals and related bills.

legislative_efforts.title: Social Media Safety Act and successor bills
legislative_efforts.status: Enacted / re-enacted; court blocks and new packages pending enforcement
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires third-party age verification and parental consent for under-18 users on covered social platforms. Earlier law permanently enjoined; 2025 successor packages face preliminary injunctions while litigation continues.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 3 Online Protections for Minors
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires social platforms to verify ages, obtain parental consent for younger users, and limit minors' exposure to certain features. District injunction later stayed on appeal; merits still contested.

legislative_efforts.title: SCOPE Act / parental-consent and app-store age rules
legislative_efforts.summary: Texas has layered minor-protection rules for digital services and app stores, including commercially reasonable age/parental mechanisms. Industry and civil-society suits challenge later app-store identity packages (e.g. SB 2420).

legislative_efforts.title: SB 976 Protecting Our Kids from Social Media Addiction Act
legislative_efforts.summary: Restricts addictive feeds and default settings for minors with parental-consent overrides. Courts have temporarily halted key provisions as First Amendment challenges proceed.

legislative_efforts.title: Parental consent for under-18 social media accounts
legislative_efforts.summary: Among the stricter US state approaches: parental consent required for minors under 18 to open social media accounts, extending beyond younger-teen-only thresholds used elsewhere.

legislative_efforts.title: Bill C-34 Safe Social Media Act
legislative_efforts.summary: Would require platforms to prohibit accounts for under-16s, with possible exemptions if strong child-safety safeguards are demonstrated. Introduced June 2026; still needs parliamentary approval.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-16 social media access + mandatory age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Government plans to ban under-16 access and force platforms to implement mandatory age-verification systems as part of a broader child online-safety agenda.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-15 social media ban with age tools
legislative_efforts.summary: Cross-party support for barring under-15s from social media, paired with digital evidence / age-verification tooling. Targeted towards mid-2026 lawmaking.

legislative_efforts.title: EU age-verification blueprint and Jutland Declaration
legislative_efforts.summary: Commission age-verification app pilots and political push for privacy-preserving age checks and a digital legal age across platforms; many member states considering national under-15/16 limits in parallel.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-13 ban; parental consent 13–15 via Digital Mobile Key
legislative_efforts.summary: Assembly approved a framework banning under-13 accounts and requiring verified parental consent for 13–15s via Digital Mobile Key, with large fines for non-compliance; final steps still tracked as pending full implementation.
